questions.chapter_title: Organic Compounds: Cycloalkanes and Their Stereochemistry
questions.topic: Organic Compounds: Cycloalkanes and Their Stereochemistry Mechanistic Step 1
questions.question: In the primary mechanism of Organic Compounds: Cycloalkanes and Their Stereochemistry (Concept 1), which statement correctly describes the reactive intermediate or electron flow?

options.label: A
options.text: Formation of key intermediate 1 via concerted electron-pair transfer.

options.label: B
options.text: Direct four-center concerted addition violating Woodward-Hoffmann orbital symmetry.

options.label: C
options.text: Unimolecular homolytic cleavage yielding high-energy free radicals without orbital overlap.

options.label: D
options.text: Spontaneous heterolysis forming an unstable primary carbanion in nonpolar media.

questions.correct_answer: Formation of key intermediate 1 via concerted electron-pair transfer.
questions.explanation: The reaction proceeds through a well-defined intermediate 1 where electron density flows from nucleophile to electrophile.
